[something-else-negative] You should not use a shared GSA wandb-integration@wandb-production.iam.gserviceaccount.com across all tenants. If one tenant is hacked that tenant can then administer and retrieve the storage contents for all customers. If you have a customer-specific GSA, even if a master GSA has serviceAccountTokenCreator on all of those customer GSAs, a code breakout within a tenant would still generally be much more protected from breakout across all tenants than in your existing model. -  dane.kantner@tempus.com
